result.title: EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation
result.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://egodepth-bench.github.io/
result.summary: We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 EgoDepth-Bench：覆盖 37 个物理环境、约 94 万条同步样本的第一视角度量深度基准，含六路标定 RGB 视图与鱼眼原生度量深度，并评测单目、双目与多视图模型的深度精度、覆盖率及留出环境上的泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 度量深度可作为探针或监督信号，用于核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要视觉信息，其对手部和物体的覆盖率统计及环境留出划分可供借鉴；但原论文不涉及 latent 推理或证据筛选，联系属推测性。
